set.tovw: Owner's own claim; official dig Nov 1935 found nothing; no outcome
pinev: 1904 Standard Atlas of Mason County: Noyes 80 (SW¼ NW¼ sec. 5 + SE¼ NE¼ sec. 6 T17N R16W) with the house mark on the 5/6 line, placed from the BLM PLSS grid; 300 m covers the whole 80
S. J. = Samuel J. Noyes, Fred's father (1910 census: Fred S. Noyes with his father Samuel J. in Eden Twp; 1920 Eden; 1930 Ludington).
Grade C: the INS, AP and Detroit News copies are treated as one wire source; placement on the 1904 family 80 is unchanged.

tw-mi-eden-twp-noyes-gold-1935.st: He dug with state troopers and a Justice Department agent; police guarded the site and digging was to resume, but no outcome was reported through Dec 1935.
src: Jackson Citizen Patriot, 7 Nov 1935, p. 1 (same wire)
